scientific_integrity: The cycle independence polynomial is classical; no new claim about its standalone enumeration is made. Finite checks corroborate, but do not prove, the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Graph orders n >= 7 only; simple unweighted graph-geodesic convexity and classical adversarial membership-query dimensions. Priority under another name for one-top augmented independence systems may remain undiscovered. No independent mathematical validation.
title: Parity-sharp VC and Littlestone dimensions of antihole geodesic convexity
